feature_definition: Welch PSD. Relative theta(4-8), alpha(8-13), beta(13-30) vs total 0.5-45 Hz. Natural-log ratios beta/theta, alpha/beta, theta/alpha. Mean over accepted windows.

quality.reject: Source flagged bad electrodes, invalid phase or insufficient coverage; both raw channels and bipolar derivation must pass non-EOG/EMG artifact checks. EOG/EMG spectral proxy flags do not reject a window.

window_grid: recording start; only fully included analysis windows in the lookback
standardization: Weighted training mean and scale, stored per model.
score: sigmoid of the model margin, higher indicates mind wandering, uncalibrated; exploratory threshold 0.5.

model_definitions.logistic: Weighted normalized logistic loss + lambda/2 times squared standardized weights.
model_definitions.rbf: Gaussian kernel exp(-squared distance/p); weighted mean squared error to {-1,+1} plus lambda times squared RKHS norm; free bias; sigmoid margin.

refit: Within each fixed family, use the all-participant fourfold inner OOF coverage-adjusted criterion (tie: scored pairs then declared parameter order); fit on all eligible records.
research_scope: Exploratory same-feature comparison after inspecting benchmark results. Use untouched new participants for confirmation. Existing collector is unchanged.
